feed.title: Teledyne e2v Expands 3D Imaging Portfolio with New Perciva ToF Camera
feed.summary: Teledyne e2v has introduced the Perciva™ ToF, an industrial-grade 3D Time-of-Flight camera designed for demanding environments. This camera integrates high-performance depth sensing with on-camera processing, making it suitable for applications such as logistics, robotics, and inspection. Powered by the Hydra3D™+ CMOS image sensor, it offers an 832 x 600 pixel resolution and patented HiRho technology, ensuring accurate 3D measurements even for fast-moving objects and in challenging outdoor conditions.

The initiative highlights a collaborative effort to bring advanced autonomous technology into mainstream retail operations in one of Europe's largest road transport markets.
